topic: Someone discovers a hidden room in their new house
text: I flicked on the light, but the bulb only flickered, casting shadows that danced like specters. The air, thick and stale, felt as if it hadn’t been disturbed in years. Dust motes hung in the weak light, swirling slowly as if reluctant to settle. The walls of this unexpected chamber seemed to close in, and every creak of the old house felt like a whisper, telling me I wasn’t alone. I took a cautious step forward, my heart pounding, and the floorboards groaned under my weight. Each shadow seemed to stretch and darken, and I couldn’t shake the sense that I was intruding on a secret better left undisturbed.
